title: Config
intro: Where we're open, {market}'s fees, cancellation terms and timers, and the feature flags. Every change needs a reason and goes to the audit log.
introReadOnly: Where TasksNearMe is open, and who's waiting in the cities still to come. Admins change a market's status, with a reason that goes to the audit log.

outage.title: Outage switch
outage.intro: Pauses new bookings and payments in {market} during an incident (the payments incident runbook). Every signed-in page shows a notice while it's on.
outage.openBody: People can book, tip and pay for changes as usual.
outage.pausedBody: Nobody can book an offer, request a helper, accept a rebook or regular visits, tip or pay for a change. Bookings that exist go ahead: scheduled charges, Pay now, refunds and transfers carry on.
outage.pauseDescription: New bookings, tips and paid changes stop at once, and every signed-in page says so. Reopen as soon as the incident is over.
outage.resumeDescription: People can book, tip and pay for changes again, and the notice goes away.

markets.title: Markets
markets.intro: A market covers the ZIP codes that start with its prefixes. Outside every open market, people join the waitlist and helpers wait for their city.
markets.readOnly: Only admins can change a market's status.
markets.name: {name}, {state}
markets.helpersSettling: Helpers yet to choose a neighborhood
markets.emailSent: {count, plural, one {Sent to # person} other {Sent to # people}}
markets.emailLater: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody to email yet} one {Goes to # person when it's live} other {Goes to # people when it's live}}
markets.emailFailed: {count, plural, one {# couldn't be sent: the email provider refused it after every retry. The launch runbook says how to send it again.} other {# couldn't be sent: the email provider refused them after every retry. The launch runbook says how to send them again.}}

refused.time_zone_unsupported: {name} can't open yet: dates and times can't be shown in its time zone ({zone}) yet. Pausing works.

leads.prelaunch: {from, select, live {{name} goes back to pre-launch. Nobody is emailed.} other {{name} opens to helpers first. Its waitlist is emailed only once it goes live.}}
leads.paused: {name} closes for now: its pages go away, and its ZIP codes count as waiting again. Nobody is emailed.

confirm.helpersIn: {count, plural, one {# helper waiting there comes in and is told to choose a neighborhood.} other {# helpers waiting there come in and are told to choose a neighborhood.}}
confirm.homePage: {name} is the home page's city: while it's paused, the home page answers "not found" too. To roll back a launch, move it to pre-launch instead: its pages stay up and nobody is emailed.
confirm.waitlistEmails: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody on its waitlist is left to email.} one {# person on its waitlist gets one email that it's open, in their language.} other {# people on its waitlist get one email that it's open, in their language.}}
